decisions: user 2026-09-30: DiD primary; H in {1,2,4,8} for a per-model lookahead curve; staged models (Qwen3-8B/14B first, 6 more pre-specified, added by versioned amendment before they run); 8-way concurrency; link to existing combat/run matrix (docs/controlled_h_v3_inference_proposal.md)

inference.order: cyclic 4x4 Latin square over H, cycled within character x sensitivity by sha256(protocol_id:order:fixture_id) rank
inference.retries: none; an in-flight query lost to a crash is recorded as ambiguous_query
inference.model_addition_rule: each additional model is added by a versioned amendment pinning its revision BEFORE it runs; same fixtures, prompts, scoring, gates and analysis; non-thinking models run with the same settings minus enable_thinking (disclosed)

analysis.primary: per character at H=8: mean_sensitive(q8-q1) - mean_control(q8-q1), sensitivity = H1/H8 optimal sets disjoint (release label); q = effective quality (truncated/unparseable/illegal = 0)
secondary: lookahead curve per model: for each H in {2,4,8}, on fixtures whose H-optimal set is disjoint from the H1-optimal set, lookahead_use_rate (response at H is H-optimal), myopic_rate (response at H is H1-optimal), ignore_baseline_rate (the H1 response is H-optimal), exact McNemar of use vs baseline, and per-H DiD with per-H labels
action switch at H8 (as lookahead curve at H=8, release labels)
legacy v2 mixture .25 sensitive + .75 control dH at H8
model contrasts: DiD and lookahead-use differences paired by fixture (exploratory until >=2 families are run)

link to the existing benchmark matrix: Spearman rank correlation across models between H8 lookahead_use_rate and (a) combat win*min(1,hp_ratio), (b) run avg_progress; exact permutation p; correlational only, n = number of models; run-level between-model variance share is ~.02 (stats_report), so (a) is the expected informative link
analysis.exclusions: fixtures with any execution failure at any H are excluded and reported; model errors stay in as quality 0
analysis.claim_scope: isolates one mechanism of long-horizon planning (lookahead use within a single decision, H<=8 transitions); not a claim about long-horizon planning in general
